decisions.reason: It builds closely on the firm's established training offer and application know-how, so absorptive capacity is high and discontinuation is unlikely.
As a fourth rotary axis accessory closely related to existing milling equipment, the firm can readily assimilate and improve it using established engineering knowledge.
Because hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the firm's established machining and dispensing expertise, its ability to interpret early results and improve the product is limited.
The high-speed CNC milling line is closest to the firm's core high-speed equipment and modular engineering capabilities, indicating very high absorptive capacity and low risk of being dropped.
An automatic tool change system builds directly on the firm's existing machine tool and accessory knowledge, allowing effective learning and improvement.
